newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Kinkel to visit China this month.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Kinkel to visit China this month.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel will visit China from October 21 to 24 for talks aimed at extending bilateral relations, the Bonn foreign ministry said on Friday.

He will visit Beijing as well as Chengdu, the capital of the western province of Sichuan, as part of a German diplomatic offensive to step up top level contacts with China, the ministry said in a statement.

Kinkel had planned to visit China in July but Beijing withdrew its invitation after the German lower house of parliament passed a resolution accusing China of trying to eradicate Tibet's cultural identity.

After a meeting on the sidelines of the United Nations general assembly in September, Kinkel and his Chinese counterpart Qian Qichen said they had ironed out any differences between China and its biggest European trade partner.

Beijing invited German President Roman Herzog to visit in November and renewed an invitation to Kinkel to visit China in preparation for Herzog's visit, indicating relations had been repaired after the row over Tibet.
A precise date has not yet been fixed for Herzog's trip.
